# Movie Bash Private Theatre Bengaluru

> Movie Bash is Bengaluru's premier private theatre and mini-cinema screening destination for couple dates, birthday celebrations, anniversaries, and family parties.

## Core Information
- **Brand**: Movie Bash Private Theatres
- **Website**: https://moviebash.in
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 99029 23656
- **Operating Hours**: Monday – Sunday, 09:30 AM – 01:00 AM (Midnight shows available)
- **Primary Locations**:
  1. **Electronic City (Active & Operational)**: 4th Floor, Srinivasam, Nagananthapura Main Road, Beside Sri Vishnu Grand, Electronic City Post, Bengaluru 560100.
  2. **BTM 2nd Stage (Upcoming / Scheduled)**: 2nd Floor, 16th Main Road, Near Udupi Garden Signal, BTM 2nd Stage, Bengaluru 560076.

## Services & Experiences
- **Couple Private Screenings**: Intimate private theatre rooms designed for 2 guests with luxury recliner seating, 4K visuals, Dolby Atmos surround sound, and optional fairy-light romantic decor. Starting at ₹899.
- **Birthday & Anniversary Celebrations**: Celebration halls equipped with party lighting, customized balloon decor, personalized welcome screens, fog entry, and artisan celebration cakes. Starting at ₹1,499.
- **Family & Group Screenings**: Private cinema lounges hosting up to 15 guests with ultra-wide 135"+ acoustic screens, comfortable seating, and party ambience.

## Key Amenities & Features
- **Cinematic Quality**: 4K Ultra HD laser projection and calibrated Dolby Atmos / multi-channel surround sound.
- **Content Streaming**: Bring your own movies or stream directly via personal OTT subscriptions (Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+ Hotstar, YouTube).
- **Celebration Add-ons**: Cold pyro sparklers, fog entry smoke effect, custom photo shoot sessions, rose petal walkway, LED occasion banners, and fresh celebration cakes.
- **Food & Beverage Policy**: Outside food allowed. Guests can bring food or order directly to the venue via Swiggy / Zomato with zero corkage fees. Plates and glasses provided.
- **Rescheduling Policy**: 1 free reschedule when requested at least 24 hours prior to the booked slot time.
